items.html: However, of the dross that was clarified from Hod, Yesod, and Malchut, in which there were still mixed parts of the aspect of ZA himself of Atzilut — behold, these did not go out in the secret of complete dross of the blood of birth; rather, they remain in the womb of the woman and are turned into milk, and ZA nurses them after he is born, and they are again clarified within him, and he grows from them.
